verdict.rationale: Paystack's API docs provide copy-paste examples that can be run via cURL. Test keys support development and testing, and the API covers programmatic payment collection, so the core of a docs-driven integration is documented. Only cURL is evidenced as an example format, and nothing shows how fast developers actually integrate. Missing for 10: evidence of examples in multiple programming languages or SDKs, evidence of an end-to-end payment-flow walkthrough, independent or hands-on corroboration of integration within a day.

support.subject: As a developer, I can integrate a working payment flow from the docs alone in under a day, with copy-paste examples in my language

citations.quote: You can copy and paste these examples into your own code or run them from the command line using cURL.
Use your test keys for development and testing, and your live keys for production.
The Paystack API lets you programmatically collect payments, manage transactions
When a request fails, the meta object contains diagnostic information that can help you debug the issue.
